title: Cross-check validates preview cost via a mirrored pricing helper, not the sim's own distances (bundle-pricing rule triplicated)
detail: The sim's Routing_Table stores no dist, so sim_dag recomputes edge costs with check_min_cost — a third copy of core's min-bundle pricing (core pass 1, min_bundle_cost, check_min_cost). A core pricing change could silently desync the displayed "route N" number while the gate stays green.
recommended_fix: Consume one shared pricing primitive in preview and check, or expose the core's per-node dist; otherwise pin the number to sim internals, not a mirrored helper. At minimum, note the rule-triplication as a sync hazard in assist.odin.

title: Routing no-op draws on the winning path still fire the preview — dag_has_edge is a pair-membership test that cannot detect a parallel-pipe no-op
detail: A parallel pipe whose tier does not lower the pair's min cost changes no routing, yet if the pair lies on the first packet's DAG (packet upstream of the pair), dag_has_edge matches and the preview fires — contradicting the claimed contract: "a draw that changes no packet's path (e.g. a parallel-pipe routing no-op) shows no glow — honest, never misleading" (PR body). S7 pins only the downstream position.
recommended_fix: Fire only when the candidate actually changes routing: the pair had no live pipe before, or the candidate strictly lowers the pair's min tier cost. Extend S7 with an upstream-packet no-op case asserting no preview.
